notes: Unresolved: (1) Truecaller's building comes from one OSM POI only (no source names the street). (2) Volkswagen's Helios Business Park site comes from one serviced-office operator's marketing sentence; VW confirms a Bengaluru site but not the building. (3) Würth India has no company-confirmed Bengaluru address (HQ Mumbai; OSM building and an IndiaMart Jakkasandra listing disagree). (4) WSP's Greenheart Phase IV block and Wipro's EC5 SEZ are not mapped, so park centroid / approximate points were kept rather than invented. (5) Vahan publishes no street address; pin is the Indiranagar locality node. (6) Wipro M3/M4 (Madiwala) and K1 (Koramangala) are OSM-only and absent from wipro.com/locations; not re-checked for budget and left low. (7) Wework.co.in lists 26 Bangalore centres; ~14 are missing from the dataset (e.g. EGL Cherry Hills/Cinnabar Hills/Princeville/Sunriver, Embassy One, Prestige Atlanta, Embassy Vertex, Jupiter Prestige Tech Park, ETV Zinnia 8C, Vaishnavi Signature, Salarpuria Magnificia, Roshni Tech Hub, IWF Campus, Infinix Palladium, Vista Earth Centre). Not added, because each would need its own geocode. (8) The Walmart Salarpuria Touchstone office was not re-verified. (9) The Cessna Business Park and Prestige Tech Pacific Park OSM polygons overlap at their shared edge; the parks may be worth reviewing.
